periods.label: Wed 28 Oct
periods.text: Southeast to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots becoming variable about 10 knots in the evening. Below 1 metre, increasing to around 1 metre offshore. Southerly around 1 metre inshore, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres offshore. Partly cloudy. 70% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm offshore north of Moruya Heads this morning.

Southerly 1 to 2 metres inshore, increasing to 2 to 3 metres offshore. Sunny.
